courses.title: Team Management for Programme Staff
courses.description: By the end of Team Management for Programme Staff, you'll be able to apply team management confidently in Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist work, with a working sense of where outcome evaluation fits alongside it. The course moves from core team management technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at outcome evaluation woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying team management to a real Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist scenario
Practicing team management through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to outcome evaluation
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying qualitative interviewing on your own.

alternates.title: Team Management Essentials
alternates.description: Team Management Essentials walks you through the basics of team management, built for people new to Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of team management, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
learning_outcomes: Applying team management to a real Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist scenario
Practicing team management through guided exercises
Building a short team management exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Advanced Team Management Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Team Management Techniques goes beyond the basics of team management, for people already working toward a Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in team management and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying team management to a real Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist scenario
Practicing team management through guided exercises
Building a short team management exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
